_meta.scope: Europe Tesla Superchargers with ownershipType=CUSTOMER_OWNED from Find Us detail pages
_meta.method: Playwright WebKit headed on Mac; page.evaluate fetch of findus detail HTML; parse __NEXT_DATA__ ownershipType. Chrome/Akamai Access Denied from this IP; curl 403. European country map params (DE/FR/GB/EU/…) return the same Customer Owned EU set.
_meta.rule: Every field is from the Tesla pull. Null/unstated when Tesla did not provide it. Never invent. US dataset is separate and untouched.
